criteria.description: The commit message's subject line (the first line) is 50 characters or fewer.
The subject line uses imperative mood, e.g. 'Expire idle sessions after 15 minutes', not 'Expired idle sessions' or 'Expires idle sessions'.
If there is a body beneath the subject line, it explains why the change was made (the motivation or problem it fixes), not merely which files or lines changed.
The message does not open with throat-clearing filler like 'This commit...' or 'This change...'.
